nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Teca Soothing Toner

avis.texte: I own at least 4 products from SKIN1004, because they really are a great skin care brand to invest in with. For reference, I have dry sensitive skin, I am prone to dark spots, some acne, dry patches and bigger pores. I have always had bad experiences with toner's so I was really hoping this would work for me. And it did more than that! I do believe my acne has gone down since using this, and to really test it out I finished the bottle after 5 and half months of daily morning and nighttime use. My skin feels smoother and bit brighter, more than anything it really keeps your skin clean without drying it out. It doesn't have a particular smell, the consistency is like water, and when you apply it is a bit tacky but no worries once it dries down completely, that goes away. This toner could be used by all skin types in my opinion. I will be trying their brightening toner soon, which I am even more excited about! Would repurchase.

I absolutely love this toner. It has a light, watery texture and feels so calming on my skin. I looked it up and it contains centella asiatica and PHA, so it’s meant to soothe while gently exfoliating and helping skin look smoother. It also has betaine, and the formula is described as good for sensitive-looking skin. For me, this has been amazing for calming irritated skin. I’ve used it on razor burn, bug bites, and spots that needed a little extra soothing, and it really helped my skin feel better. It feels fresh, not heavy or sticky, and I love how gentle it is. If I could give it 10 stars, I would. This bottle has officially earned “tiny skincare miracle worker” status in my house.

I have my mothers head shape and facial features and my dad’s eyes and huge pores. I’ve always tried to use products in my skin care routine that help shrink pores. And this product is by far the best I’ve used. It isn’t going to make pores completely disappear, let’s be real, only beauty filters and editing your photos does that, but this toner will make your pores significantly smaller. It has also helped even my skin tone and keep it feeling pretty smooth and soft. I’ve been using the same bottle for almost 2 months. I use it twice a day; during my morning and evening skin care routine. I pour a bit in my left palm and push both palms together before applying it to my face. I push it into my skin rather than rubbing it all over and I’ve found toners to be more effective with this application. I also have the corresponding face wash and poremizing fresh ampoule.

avis.titre: I think I found something that works!
avis.texte: Hi 61 (f) that has developed ruddy rosacea prone skin as I have aged. I've used extraordinarily expensive skincare trying to resolve the issues. But nothing has seemed to work. I started using the SKIN1004 Centella series of products. Toners normally dry my skin and make the problems worse. Not this one. It is exactly what my routine needed. I'm more than pleased to find these great products. I have even found a makeup that I can use that doesn't cause me to break out. It's a new world for this old lady!

avis.titre: Good but not for sensitive skin
avis.texte: packaging is good quality, it's lightweight, you only need to put like 6 drops to cover your whole face. I returned it because it caused me fungal acne, but this is mostly because of my skin type (Acne-Prone, Sensitive, Combination Skin) If it wasn't for this. I would say it's a good product, didn't irritate my skin but I actually didn't saw any major changes on my skin

Used this for the first time last night and right away I can tell how great of a product this is going to be. I have been using the SKIN1004 Poremizing Clay Stick and I love that product. I am sure this product will be just as good! Using this on my Night 4 Total Barrier Repair Skincare Routine Cycle and it worked extremely well with my other products!

Such a wonderful product. I bought a few items from this line last year and immediately became hooked. It's effective with no harsh scent. It's not sticky. I definitely saw some changes in my skin and honestly this lasts a long time.

Such a gentle toner— I have very finicky skin because I am chronically ill, and I’m on immunosuppressants and I do struggle with breakouts here and there due to those medications. This toner is so gentle and just makes my skin glow and look so healthy and feel so healthy. I’m on my second bottle and they last really long— I don’t use a cotton round, I put it in the palm of my hand and put it directly into my skin just kind of pressing it in—I’d recommend this to anyone for a gentle effective toner.
Fa il suo dovere, lo uso per la prima volta e sicuramente lo ricomprerò
This tonic is so lightweight, leaving face moisturised and refreshed - perfect after cleansing and before creams/ serums
This is my favorite toner I love it I even bedazzled it lol but I like how it feels and makes my face feel nice

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Estoy encantada con este tónico de SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella. Desde los primeros días noté mi piel mucho más hidratada, suave y calmada. Tengo la piel un poco sensible y este producto no me irritó para nada. La textura es ligera, se absorbe rápido y deja una sensación fresca sin sentirse pegajoso. También me ayudó a que mi piel se viera más luminosa y saludable. Algo que me gustó mucho es que el envase dura bastante porque no necesitas usar demasiado producto. Además, tiene ingredientes muy buenos para cuidar la barrera de la piel. Definitivamente lo volvería a comprar y lo recomiendo si buscas un toner hidratante y calmante para tu rutina de skincare. 💖
Def worth it i use this brand and this product make my face feel refreshed

avis.titre: Filipina Combination skin type (not acne prone)
avis.texte: Half way used! I make sure to try it for a month first before dropping my review and I must say it helps my skin especially during winter! I experienced flakiness and itchiness on winter and this helps a lot! As a Filipina who came from tropical country with combination skin, not acne prone skin but tend to get 1 or 2 pimples if my period is coming but when I moved in the US my skin is really dry and itchy! and this toner helps me a lot 🥹!! ♥️

avis.titre: Arrived with broken seal, but inner seal was intact
avis.texte: The box arrived with a broken seal, which made me concerned at first. However, the inner product seal was intact and difficult to open, so it appeared to be properly sealed. Because of that, I decided to use it. The product itself seemed fine, but I would recommend checking the seal carefully upon delivery just to be safe. Sharing my experience in case it helps other buyers.
If you have sensitive skin, this product is essential for your skincare routine. It is excellent; I experience frequent acne breakouts, and it helps soothe my skin.

avis.titre: Gentle exfoliation but not my favorite scent
avis.texte: For reference, I have combo skin (oily t-zone and dry chin/cheeks), with hormonal acne. I use tretinoin roughly 3-4 days per week to help with the hormonal acne on my, chin and jawline, this has caused me to have some dry patches in those areas. I do not have sensitive skin or eyes, as I can use direct acids and most fragrances without irritation. I also have some slight pitting from acne scaring. I prefer unscented or lightly scented products and light weight/gel textured products when possible. This Teca toner with LHA for soothing, moisturizing and gentle exfoliation does most of what the listing states. I did find that it was moisturizing and gentle exfoliation. I did not find it soothing tho, actually the opposite, it has a bit of a stinging sensation if I use it twice daily. I have found that using it just at bedtime or every other day works best for my skin. However, I am not a fan of the scent of the product. The scent is not very strong, but it is unpleasant enough that I did not look forward to using it. Of course, scent is very personal and it was not a bad chemical smell, just not a scent profile that I like. The price point is reasonable at $20 for a 200ml/7 oz bottle or $2.82/ounce for this toner that should last about 6 months with daily use. If it was not for the scent, then I would consider repurchasing this for the gentle exfoliation.

I've been using this wonderful toner daily for nearly 2 months and it has made a noticeable difference from day 1. The first thing I noticed is the pleasant natural scent. While very mild, it's light and fruity, slightly nutty. The bottle is a generous size, yet it is easy to hold and to disburse a few drops into your palm or onto a cloth. I typically use a mesh cloth because I enjoy seeing that it exfoliates and removes excess dirt that my face wash I use prior has missed. Upon application it absorbs almost instantly and makes my skin tingle. It leaves no sticky residue, only a healthy glow as shown in photo 2. It softens skin and makes it feel hydrated all day. It even smooths the appearance of fine lines. There is a soothing effect, and the longer I used it, the more balanced my face became. I no longer have any oily or dry spots. It's a great find I highly recommend!

avis.titre: Great addition to my skincare routine!
avis.texte: I am a chronic product searcher as you can tell I have such combination skin that one day I need something for dry skin other times my skin is so oily I need a more cleansing toner. As you can see I have two one is a milk toner for my hydration and the other is this toner and to be honest I like this one better its much more kind to my skin and smells wayyyyyy better then the other one by far. If you are looking for something that will give you zero irritation you can’t lose with this madagascar soothing toner and honestly I have found Korean products just excel beyond American products in my belief. I’ve pretty much switched my skincare over to highly reviewed Korean brands and my skin is just doing way better. I used to do Olay and Revlon and yeah those don’t touch the various way better options they have out there. Just make sure those with this toner you get yourself some cotton balls it doesn’t have a cool pump like you see in other brands, but a bag of 100 cotton balls will set you back a dollar. As you can tell I take my skin care very seriously and unfortunately love to switch it up (much to the delight of my friends that get to try out different products) and as my mom says “Marketers love you,” but what can I say when I see something cool or different why not? My skin is often like hair I feel like I constantly need to be switching things up. But my toners tend to be a stable staple in my routine something I always use til they are empty so the fact that I have more

avis.titre: Had a bad skin reaction to it
avis.texte: I was so excited to get this in the mail and bought the entire routine, however when I put this toner on I started breaking out immediately all over my face in these irritated/itchy patches. I had to wash my face immediately and take allergy medicine to hope it recedes....

SKIN1004’s Madagascar Centella TECA Soothing Toner is one of my favorites. It offers a balance between calming and lightly refining the skin. The texture is very lightweight, like a thick water. It is slightly hydrating and layers very well if you have a multi step skincare routine. Regarding ingredients, this toner contains centella asiatica, also known as cica, is the famous tiger grass plant from Madagascar used for wound soothing. It’s currently a very trendy ingredient in Korean skincare and has been distilled into its most potent extract through the TECA process. My skin feels so much less irritated every time I use this toner. Let’s say you’ve been out in the sun too long, caked your face in makeup, or had a fast food binge session. Your skin is bound to be a bit sensitive or red. This toner has endless mercy and will heal it all without questions. I noticed this product also contains LHA, a slower derivative of BHA, which will provide a very mild exfoliation. It’s not as strong or noticeable as BHAs like salicylic acid or a physical exfoliant, but over time your skin will feel a bit smoother and look a bit more even in tone, too. The bottle is a generous size. 210ml! So you know it will last a while even with daily or consistent use. I have found this is the best size bottle for lasting results. If you are looking for a soothing, lightweight toner with a gentle exfoliating effect, especially if you have sensitive or damaged skin and need something non-irritating, this

This "Madagascar Centella TECA Soothing Toner" has a water-type formula that feels super lightweight, soothing and refreshing on the skin. It is suitable for all skin types and I especially enjoy using it during the daytime because it absorbs quickly, feels non-sticky and easy to apply. I prefer not to use cotton pads. I simply dab a generous amount onto my face, neck and even my arms. Since I have dry skin, I like to layer it with a milky toner, serum and moisturizer for extra hydration. It has a subtle nice tea-like scent. No skin irritation. Considering its unique formula, effectiveness, high quality, and generous size, I find the price to be quite reasonable. Overall, this is a great toner and ideal for days when I want quick hydration and soothing care in the morning or extra skin comfort in my nighttime routine. Recommended!

avis.titre: Calm, Hydrated Skin Without the Heavy Feel — Perfect Daily Toner
avis.texte: This SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella TECA Soothing Toner is one of those products that quietly becomes a staple in your routine. If your skin leans sensitive, reactive, or easily irritated like mine sometimes does, this is such a good one to have on hand. The texture is super lightweight — almost watery — but it still feels hydrating. It doesn’t just sit on the surface; it actually absorbs and leaves your skin feeling calm and refreshed. What I really like: - it instantly reduces that tight, dry feeling after cleansing - helps calm redness and irritation - layers beautifully (I sometimes do 2–3 layers for extra hydration) The gentle exfoliation from LHA is a nice bonus. It’s not harsh at all — just enough to keep your skin smooth over time without causing irritation. This is the kind of toner that works for pretty much anyone, but especially if you’re trying to repair your skin barrier or keep things simple and soothing. It’s not flashy, but it works — and that’s exactly why I keep using it.

This toner arrives in a box with a 2.125 square base and is 6 inches tall. The bottle itself is a light brown color and is 5.75 inches tall and about 1.75 inches wide. The top of the bottle (where the toner comes out) is 0.75 inches wide, so there is plenty of room if you wish to press a cotton pad to the top of the bottle to apply the toner that way. The recommended life of the toner is a year from when it's opened. Even with daily use, I can see this bottle lasting for at least a few months. My skin is sensitive and combination-dry, and I did not have any bad reactions. If you have sensitive skin, I would recommend applying some to your wrist to make sure it will not cause any issues. The toner is clear with a VERY slight earthy scent. The toner is lightweight, watery, and not sticky at all. If you skin needs some extra hydration, this toner is very easy to layer before moving onto the next step in your beauty routine. One thing to note is that since this has an AHA / BHA component, this could result in sensitivity to the sun so make sure you are careful if those types of products cause a reaction. If you want it to be extra soothing, you may want to try storing it in the fridge.

I am seriously impressed with this toner. Since I started using tretinoin my skin has been so picky and I have to be really careful about what I put on my face. Most products just end up making my skin feel even more dry or irritated but this one is actually amazing. It feels so soothing the second it touches my face. It has helped my dryness by a lot which is a huge win for me. It is a gentle exfoliator with LHA but it does not sting or cause any issues with my skin. I love that it includes centella to help with the skin barrier because that is exactly what I need right now. The texture is great and it absorbs into my skin quickly without feeling sticky. I usually just pat it on with my palms and it makes my face feel hydrated and balanced. If you are struggling with dry skin from strong treatments like I am this is definitely worth trying. It has become a major step in my daily routine. I definitely recommend and the value is on point!

I absolutely adored this toner! It really was truly soothing, calming to my skin and deeply hydrating. It didn't just sit on top of the skin and fully absorbed without leaving behind any stickiness or residue. I also noticed absolutely no scent and the smallest amount went the longest way. This is a fairly large bottle and will last the longest time with the small amount you need to use. i was very surprised with the hydration this helped provide. I did layer it with a moisturizer as well after full dry down. As an avid skincare enjoyer and purchaser I would absolutely repurchase this product and would highly recommend it!
Never have I ever used a toner mostly because I was not well versed on how to use it this is an amazing buy and so easy to use. Very happy with my purchase.

avis.titre: No smell, and gentle on skin. Does not irritate my mild rosacea.
avis.texte: I have mild rosacea and very sensitive skin, plus I react to fragrances and strong scents. I was cautious trying this Korean toner but hopeful after a family recommendation. It has no detectable smell and hasn’t irritate my skin at all. The lightweight, watery texture absorbs quickly without stickiness. I apply it with a cotton ball (a little goes a long way) or pat it in with clean hands at night before bed. I noticed after the very first use, my skin felt calmer and more balanced by the next morning—noticeably less redness and dryness. It provides good hydration while the LHA offers very gentle exfoliation without any stinging or tightness. I am enjoying using it very much. Pros: Fragrance-free, soothing for rosacea-prone skin, economical (210ml lasts well), and visible results fast. Cons: None for my skin type so far. I will update in the future if any issues should arise. This is a quality product I'll repurchase. Great option if you need a calming, no-fuss toner.

avis.titre: good toner for those that need to improve skin tone and sebum control
avis.texte: I like this brand and this product. A hydrating toner is always a must for my super dry skin. I use this one three times a week because it has vitamin c and niacinamide in it, and my skin is sensitive and reactive so I dont like to overload it with actives. The consistency is like water. I just pour some into my hand and rub my palms together then pat it into my face. No noticeable scent to me, and the product absorbs instantly. I follow up with the Skin1004 centella soothing cream and of course spf for light hydration in the mornings. $22 for the size is fair market value especially for a toner with skin tone evening and brightening ingredients.

I love the way this makes my skin feel. I have acne-prone/oily/sensitive/reactive skin for reference. This toner leaves my skin blemish-free, soft, supple, plump, and moisturized. It’s great at rebalancing my skin’s chemistry and in turn leaving me with a brighter complexion (without redness). This is a toner that I actually want to use and keep going back to again and again. It just works and is a pleasure to use. I wet 3 cotton rounds with toner and carefully dab my face with them. It dries and absorbs quickly into the skin. Works well with other products and is just plain reliable. This one is a winner for sure, especially for those of us with very sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Centella Asiatica Extract - commonly known as Gotu kola
avis.texte: I'm loving this facial toner on my mature skin! Non-drying, non-irritating and feels great. I actually look forward to using this. Non-stinging. I've tried different types of facial toner and some sting, and some dry my skin so much it draws it tight, and I have to grab moisturizer to compensate, so I just haven't been fond of toner - until now! I love how this feels. My skin is well abused, so I can't attest to the lightening of dark spots (yet), but I can say it does brighten my dual skin and gives me that fresh clean glow. And I don't feel the need to use moisturizers just to correct dry skin caused by a facial toner. Worth the price for a product that feels so comfortable, and it's a huge bottle so will last a very long time.

Not only is this 84% centella, but it also contains PHA, niacinamide, and hydraulic acid which means it is calming but also gently exfoliating. This toner has been a great boost to my hyperpigmentation targeting products.

I got this when it was on sale so i gave it a try and i’m in love. It really sooths my skin and i notice that little bumbs from irritation start to disappear. I dont see if it helps fading acne scars yet. But i can’t live without this one now.
This is a perfect toner for those with dry/irritated skin! It calms irritation quickly, & leaves the skin super hydrated! Also a good sized bottle for the price as well!
I absolutely love this toner; it leaves my skin super hydrated and without any oily residue. It's quite large and inexpensive. I highly recommend it.

I’ve been using the Centella toner, and I absolutely love it! My skin feels so much better — smoother, calmer, and more refreshed. I’ve noticed a real improvement in texture and overall appearance. It’s now a must-have in my skincare routine! 🌿✨
I like the product and have previously bought the product from Olive Young. However the one I got from Amazon all have the box seal opened upon receiving it.
Muy buen producto siempre cotejo en aplicaciones de control de calidad y tiene la mayoría de complementos nocivos.

It looks like water, moves like water, and feels like water…and YET. I’ve been using this in the morning, and I don’t understand how it’s managed to brighten up my skin when it just seems like water. It’s hydrating but not overly so, so it doesn’t leave any tackiness after I pat it in. And it’s surprisingly soothing, I use it even when my skin seems irritated and it doesn’t negatively affect my skin. No scent, and it layers with other products just fine. It also seems to have helped with my pores! They’re less likely to get clogged, inadvertently making them smaller. It wasn’t advertised for that, but I’m SO happy about it lol. It’s got Centella Asiatica Extract and Madecassoside, and I can definitely tell with how nicely this hydrates and brightens my overall complexion. I would recommend this, don’t be fooled by its unassuming appearance!
It is very soothing for the skin, it lasts a lot, has a very decent amount of product, it is light weight and has no smell, definitely will buy again, worth the hype

avis.titre: TECA Madagascar Centella High Quality Toner
avis.texte: I already had gotten a TECA Madagascar Centella sunscreen that I really liked, so this toner is a nice complement to use with that. It is extremely soothing and moisturizing; so much so, in fact, that I actually poured this into an empty misting bottle that I had, and I am using it on my face and body, especially after I towel off after my shower, to help hold in the moisture before applying my moisturizer. I spray it and then pat it into my skin and let it dry briefly, and then I apply the moisturizer and/or sunscreen. This is a great addition to my skincare routine, and I appreciate the safe, high-end ingredients in this toner. It scores an Excellent 86/100 on the Yuka app.
